result.summary: The intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals, despite being controlled by traffic lights. The wide roadway and lack of designated crossing areas create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians in a commercial area.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian-specific signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to interpret vehicle signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide expanse of the roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to moving traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to improve predictability and safety.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image depicts a signalized urban intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure, including sidewalks, a marked crosswalk, and pedestrian signals. However, the crosswalk markings are significantly faded, and parked vehicles near the corner create potential sightline obstructions.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The continental-style crosswalk markings are worn and faded, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corner can block the view of pedestrians waiting to cross from the perspective of oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the crossing

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Repainting
interventions.description: Refresh the crosswalk with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness and compliance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The intersection is signalized but lacks basic pedestrian safety features such as marked crosswalks, dedicated pedestrian signals, and ADA-compliant curb ramps. The roadway surface is in poor condition with extensive cracking, and the lack of lane markings creates an undefined environment for both drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians with no designated path.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Significant cracking and uneven roadway surfaces create tripping hazards and may affect vehicle control.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian-specific signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals which may not provide adequate crossing time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility ladder or zebra-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to improve predictability and safety for people crossing.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install compliant curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all crossing points.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, a marked crosswalk, and signalization. However, the environment is degraded by faded pavement markings, poor road surface quality, and a large utility pole that partially obstructs the corner clearance.

hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.
